premise: After a long swim Seal flops onto the warm rocks; Gull asks why she isn't swimming, and soon everyone is resting in the sun with her.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Wind and the Sun' turned around: nobody has to be persuaded, the warm sun simply wins everyone over.
lesson: Rest is good for you too.
learning: Seals climb out onto rocks to rest and warm up in the sun.

en-US.title: Seal Warms Up
en-US.text: {seal:enter by swim} {seal:go to sea by swim} Seal was swimming in the cool blue sea, swish, swish, swish. {seal:face happy} After a long swim, she {seal:go to rocks} flopped out onto the rocks, {sfx:flop} splosh, {canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s} right into the sunshine. [sighs] Ahhh. {seal:face sleeping} [short pause] {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gull came flapping down beside her. {seagull:live} Gull squawked. [curious] Why are you lying about on the rocks, Seal? The sea is for swimming! {seal:face happy} [warmly] Swimming makes me chilly, said Seal. So seals climb out to rest, and warm up in the sun. Try it! {seagull:face surprised} {seagull:wobble} Gull tried it. Oh! It WAS warm. {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelican came gliding down too, {pelican:face happy} and spread out his big white wings. [softly] {seal:live} Seal gave a happy little clap. {seagull:face sleeping} {pelican:face sleeping} [whispers] And for a while, the rocks were the quietest, warmest, sleepiest place of all. {seal:hearts}

es-ES.title: Foca entra en calor
es-ES.text: {seal:enter by swim} {seal:go to sea by swim} Foca nadaba por el mar azul y fresquito, fis, fis, fis. {seal:face happy} Después de nadar un buen rato, {seal:go to rocks} subió a las rocas de un salto, {sfx:flop} ¡chof!, {canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s} justo al sol. [sighs] Aaah. {seal:face sleeping} [short pause] {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gaviota bajó aleteando a su lado. {seagull:live} Gaviota graznó. [curious] ¿Qué haces tumbada en las rocas, Foca? ¡El mar es para nadar! {seal:face happy} [warmly] Nadar me da fresquito, dijo Foca. Por eso las focas salen a descansar y a calentarse al sol. ¡Pruébalo! {seagull:face surprised} {seagull:wobble} Gaviota lo probó. ¡Anda! Se estaba calentito DE VERDAD. {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelícano bajó planeando también, {pelican:face happy} y extendió sus grandes alas blancas. [softly] {seal:live} Foca dio una palmadita feliz. {seagull:face sleeping} {pelican:face sleeping} [whispers] Y durante un rato, las rocas fueron el sitio más tranquilo, calentito y dormilón de todos. {seal:hearts}

flop.prompt: a seal flopping out of the water onto a wet rock, a wet splash and slap, realistic
